Reviewer: L1-b (seat 3, area ux-D). Contract review: none owed. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, no `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed rule text.
Tier: not Tier H. This is card #36955's only PR, 18 files, 279 changed lines. `check-governed-merges --pr 36974`: not governed.

### Read
- Net diff `origin/main...9df9b39a`, the PR body, card #36955, claim 7130471991, the surface amendments 7131602500 and 7133172172, and dev report 7133136074.
- Check-runs on `9df9b39a`: 46 success, 15 expected skip, 0 failed. One re-run of `Check Changeset` started at 13:41:31Z, after a body edit, and was still running when I read the checks. The earlier `Check Changeset` run on this same head (13:09Z) is success, and the changeset is unchanged.

### Checklist
- **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #36955`.
- **Scope.** The 11 console locale packs, `SearchResultsPage.tsx` (the `SearchResult` type union), `global-search-renderer.tsx` (the default placeholder and aria label), the new pin, the `global-page-blocks` accessible-name test, the en-drift baseline and its test, and the changeset. The two amendments cover every file outside the first claim.
- **The cause is fixed at the root.** The page builds its keys as `search.type<Type>s` and `search.badge<Type>`. Every pack now carries `typeComponents`, `typeDocs` and `typeUrls`, plus `badgeComponent`, `badgeDoc` and `badgeUrl`. That fixes the reported pair, and also `url` (link) items, which the card did not name and which printed raw keys too. Badges stay lowercase, like the existing `badgeObject` / `badgePage`.
- **Translations.** I read en, zh-Hans, ja and ar. Each is natural and consistent with the pack's existing words: zh 组件 / 文档 / 链接, ja コンポーネント / ドキュメント / リンク. The placeholder and the aria label name components and docs in every pack.
- **Drift waiver.** `search.placeholder` changes in en and in all ten translations in the same commit, so its en-drift waiver has expired. It is deleted, and `WAIVER_CEILING` goes from 7 to 6. Right.
- **Pin.** The new test reads the types from `NavigationItemTypeSchema.options` and walks `builtInLocales`. If the spec adds a navigation type, or a pack drops a row, the test fails. That is a stronger guard than listing the three new keys.
- **Changeset.** `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Right.
- **Card acceptance.** Components and docs get a translated heading and badge in every shipped locale: met, plus links. Pinned across all 11 packs.

### Findings
No must-fix, no should-fix.

- **N1 (nit).** The placeholder names components and docs but not links. This matches the card, which asks only for the two newer kinds. Link items do not live in an app's searchable pages in the same way, so leaving them out of the hint is reasonable.

### Note to the seat
- Not Tier H, not governed, no L2 owed. ux-D can land it through the relay once the `Check Changeset` re-run finishes. `Fixes #36955` closes the card at merge.
